p.s: The number of cars in use rappresents a complex variable to study.
Actually we can describe this variable like a constant expansion as nowadays we can consider car as a status symbol.
Most of the people uses car everyday and for any reasons, such as going to work, to shop or to holyday.
In my opinion now there is not a valide alternative to change this way of life.
Public transportation, like bus, metro is not efficient as people required: not all city blocks can be easily reached without waste too much time, and vehicle are less comfortable than own car.
For these reasons I think that number of cars in use will continue to increase without a serious and global transportation politics.
If I go arond I can see the highest percentage of cars occupied from the driver only, familes that have more cars than persons in house, and on the other hand a bad plublic transportation.
